summary: Frontend testing of the 3 new features in panel-shift-team (ShiftTeamCall) per iteration_215 request. All acceptance criteria PASSED on desktop 1920x900.

issues: The full-screen 'CYBER-TRIO / Enter the console' avatar overlay still appears above the console right after login. It is dismissible via the top-right X (kiosk-modal-close) but adds friction to reaching panel-shift-team. Consider auto-dismiss for return visits.

critical_code_review_comments: Master Gate admin-key-* buttons work reliably only via JS element.click(); Playwright mouse-based clicks can be dropped when triggered in rapid succession.
Post-login 'CYBER-TRIO' overlay: X button uses data-testid=kiosk-modal-close but its 'Enter the console' CTA has no data-testid — recommend adding one (e.g., cyber-trio-enter) for stable E2E.
test_credentials: Master Gate PIN 1985; Capo admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026!
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed. Baseline: shift-team-empty visible (no assegnazioni oggi). After clicking shift-team-recreate: today (2026-09-06) got Panificio (Marco/forni, Youssef/impasti) + Laugen (Ali/brezel), matching ieri 2026-09-05.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FEATURE 1 (Ricrea ultimo turno) PASS: click shift-team-recreate → toast 'Turno del 2026-09-05 ricreato ✓' visible, shift-team-dept-panificio + shift-team-dept-laugen groups appear with correct operators/tasks. FEATURE 2 (Esporta CSV) PASS: shift-team-export triggers download mikilab_storico_turni_2026-09-06.csv (captured via page.expect_download). No console errors. shift-team-history-toggle expands shift-team-history showing both shift-history-2026-09-05 and shift-history-2026-09-06. FEATURE 3 (Badge Presenza) PASS: shift-presence-Youssef has class with bg-[#22c55e] and title='presente'; shift-presence-Marco & shift-presence-Ali have grey bg and title='assente'. REGRESSIONS PASS: shift-team-announce, shift-team-speak-panificio, shift-team-auto-toggle all clickable with no pageerrors. Only console errors observed were expected /api/auth/me 401 pre-login. Use JS .click() on admin-key-* buttons for reliable PIN entry.
